item.description:
## New Features
- Format Codex subagent display names as Role: Nickname - path label (with trailing ellipsis truncation) and automatically backfill existing records.
## Fixes
- Keep empty-state overview, trend, and speed cards at a stable layout with zeroed values instead of collapsing their size. - Align the Speed tab chart and breakdown colors with the updated overview palette. - Fix zero-usage and failed subagent row alignment, remove legacy leading disclosure chevrons in favor of clean indentation, and fix nested hover highlight clipping. - Prevent background scans from locking the toolbar refresh icon in a spinning state.
